ideas.title: Following the Money in Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail of child care fraud, including the use of federal funds and the involvement of shell companies.
questions: How much federal funding is involved in child care programs?
What shell companies are involved in the fraud?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can uncover the extent of the fraud and identify those responsible. This investigation could lead to significant recoveries of federal funds and accountability for those involved.
